correctness.rationale: Diagonalization, real scaling and sign cover all trace-free nonzero 3-by-3 real symmetric matrices. Compression to a generic great circle has cofactor-determinant sign; the Crofton constant L=π E[N] agrees with Gichev equation (20), specialized to S². Conditional integration gives exactly L/(4π)=E_phi sqrt(U/(U+s)). Pairing phi and phi+π/2 reduces the lower bound to two exact polynomial inequalities: 2k-s-4s²=d²(3-2v²-d²)/4≥0 and 5k-4s(1+s)=d²(6-5v²-d²)/4≥0, with strictness unless d=0. The endpoint a=0 is handled separately. Therefore sharp lower and both classifications hold for all real quadratic harmonics. Two identities were verified symbolically and Crofton/direct-arclength methods numerically agreed at eight parameter values; finite tests alone do not prove the infinite statement.

value.rationale: Gichev identifies zonal nodal length as a plausible universal lower envelope; establishing it exactly in the first nontrivial harmonic degree resolves a motivated natural sharp problem, with geometric equality classes. The result handles all real trace-free 3-by-3 symmetric matrices, and the proof supplies an exact nodal-length profile and an explicit positive decomposition. It does not rely on arbitrary parameter cutoffs or routine numerical enumeration, and it does not claim the previously known 4π upper inequality as new.
